post.title: [TASK] 200 product descriptions for my store - $3 each
post.body: Online homeware store. Need 200 product descriptions, about 80 words each. I will give you the product name and specs in a sheet. $3 per description. Need it done in two weeks.

analysis.summary: Write 200 product descriptions of about 80 words each for a homeware store at $3 each, within two weeks.
